scenarios.title: A｜解释自己的感受
scenarios.setting: 伴侣最近经常临时改变两人的计划，玩家对此感到不满。

turns.text: I already said I was sorry. I didn’t know work would come up.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know, but I was disappointed because I’d been looking forward to seeing you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but I was disappointed because I’d been looking forward to seeing you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not angry that you had to work. I’m upset that you didn’t tell me until the last minute.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not angry that you had to work. I’m upset that you didn’t tell me until the last minute.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand things come up, but this has happened several times recently.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand things come up, but this has happened several times recently.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I just want you to understand why it bothered me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just want you to understand why it bothered me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You always ruin our plans because of work.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but I was disappointed because I’d been looking forward to seeing you.
feedback.explanation: 情绪化、绝对化

turns.text: I wasn’t trying to upset you. I just didn’t think it was that big a deal.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I know you didn’t mean to, but it still made me feel like our plans weren’t important.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you didn’t mean to, but it still made me feel like our plans weren’t important.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe it doesn’t feel like a big deal to you, but it matters to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe it doesn’t feel like a big deal to you, but it matters to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not saying you did it on purpose. I’m explaining how it made me feel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying you did it on purpose. I’m explaining how it made me feel.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I wish you’d told me earlier instead of leaving me waiting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wish you’d told me earlier instead of leaving me waiting.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Okay. I didn’t realize you felt that way.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That’s why I wanted to talk about it instead of just staying upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s why I wanted to talk about it instead of just staying upset.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I just want us to communicate better when plans change.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just want us to communicate better when plans change.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜双方意见不同
scenarios.setting: 在“发生争吵”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“双方意见不同”。

turns.text: I don’t think couples need to text each other all day.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I agree we don’t need to talk constantly, but I’d like a little more communication.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree we don’t need to talk constantly, but I’d like a little more communication.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I see it differently. Staying in touch regularly is important to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see it differently. Staying in touch regularly is important to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand your point, but I don’t think I’m asking us to talk all day.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand your point, but I don’t think I’m asking us to talk all day.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe we just have different expectations about communication.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we just have different expectations about communication.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If you cared about me, you’d want to talk to me more.

feedback.naturalExpression: I agree we don’t need to talk constantly, but I’d like a little more communication.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达存在语法或语境问题。更建议说：“I agree we don’t need to talk constantly, but I’d like a little more communication.”

turns.text: I just don’t want to feel like I have to reply immediately whenever you text me.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That’s fair. I don’t expect you to reply immediately.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fair. I don’t expect you to reply immediately.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand. What bothers me is when I don’t hear from you for a whole day.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. What bothers me is when I don’t hear from you for a whole day.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe we can find something that works for both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we can find something that works for both of us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Would it help if we were clearer about when we’re busy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it help if we were clearer about when we’re busy?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Yeah. If I’m busy, I could just let you know.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That would make a big difference to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would make a big difference to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yeah, that’s really all I’m asking for.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s really all I’m asking for.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think that sounds like a reasonable compromise.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think that sounds like a reasonable compromise.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜暂停争论
scenarios.setting: 两个人已经争论了一段时间，情绪越来越激动。

turns.text: We’re just going in circles now.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Yeah. I think we should take a break and talk about this later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I think we should take a break and talk about this later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: We’re both getting upset. Can we come back to this when we’ve calmed down?

feedback.naturalExpression: We’re both getting upset. Can we come back to this when we’ve calmed down?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t want to say something I’ll regret. Maybe we should stop for now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to say something I’ll regret. Maybe we should stop for now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I still want to resolve this, but I don’t think we’re getting anywhere right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still want to resolve this, but I don’t think we’re getting anywhere right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Fine. I don’t want to talk to you anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I think we should take a break and talk about this later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达存在语法或语境问题。更建议说：“Yeah. I think we should take a break and talk about this later.”

turns.text: So you just want to walk away from the conversation?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: No. I want to continue the conversation, just not while we’re both this upset.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I want to continue the conversation, just not while we’re both this upset.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not avoiding it. I just think we need some time to cool down.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not avoiding it. I just think we need some time to cool down.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I promise we’ll talk about it later. I just need a little space right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I promise we’ll talk about it later. I just need a little space right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could we take an hour and talk again afterward?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we take an hour and talk again afterward?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Okay. Let’s talk again later tonight.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. I think that’ll be better for both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I think that’ll be better for both of us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll talk to you later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll talk to you later.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
